# S1.12 — Land the egress / network policy & sandbox boundaries (§5g.4, R-2.8.4 C0/Stage 1)

**Spec:** `spec/CANONICAL_SPEC.md` §5g.4 (`R-2.8.4` — the C0/Stage-1 slice per
§5g.4 §9) · ADR-0060/0061/0062 (as amended) · ADR-0023/0024 · ADR-0030/0031 ·
ADR-0033/0034/0035 · ADR-0036/0037 · ADR-0049/0050 · ADR-0052/0053 ·
ADR-0130 · ADR-0212 (OQ-132 interim)
**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/016_S1.12__egress-network.md`
**Requirement ids stamped:** **R-2.8.4**
**Base:** `svitali/harnessharness-s1.11` (stacked) · **Stage:** 1 · **Live
stage:** offline-only

## Summary
Lands the containment floor's C0/Stage-1 slice as the new **persistent**
crate `crates/hh-containment` (deps `hh-identity`/`hh-provenance`/`hh-wire`/
`hh-ledger`/`hh-monitor` only — no `Text` leaf, no model call on the
admission path), plus the recorded-gate edge into `hh-monitor`:

- **`ContainmentPolicy/1`** (`policy.rs`) — the §3 record verbatim
  (`fs`/`net`/`proc`/`resources`/`amendment`/`residual_channels`/`ext` +
  `provenance`), `KERNEL_PROTECTED`, `KERNEL_DENY`, the deny-by-default
  `kernel_default`, the strict canonical codec (`BadMember` on unknown
  members — CC4), `policy_id` (semantic projection: normalised policy
  members only) and `version_id` (exact bytes incl. provenance/ext) both
  through `hh_identity` (CC1; T-LCD-10), and `HostRule`/`HostPattern`/
  `NetMode` schema-complete for `mediated`/`public` at Stage 1.
- **`effective(layers)`** (`meet.rs`) — authority-ordered monotone meet:
  narrowing lands free at any class; loosening lands only by entitlement
  (`kernel` any field; `principal` `net.mode`/allow-rules/writable
  roots/`amendment.strict`; `definition` mounts/resource-raises/allow-rules
  *with justification*; below, `ContainmentWidening` — ADR-0243 §2). Deny
  sets union, allow sets intersect, stricter bools win; `None` on an
  `Option` bound means "no declaration" (never removal); `KERNEL_PROTECTED`
  names exempt via `ProtectedPathExemption`.
- **`admits(policy, proposal)`** (`admit.rs`) — `Admitted | Refused{reason}
  | Amendable{diagnoses}` over canonical scope args; deny-before-allow;
  protected-path and read-only-subpath handling; `required_field_groups`
  per domain; `unreachable_permissions` warnings (never a refusal);
  `floor_gate` producing the monitor's `ContainmentGate` (`Amendable` is
  denial at Stage 1 — `amend()` is Stage 2).
- **`ContainmentReport` + evidence** (`report.rs`) —
  `attested`/`reported`/`probed`/`unknown`, never coerced (T-LCD-07);
  `verify_report` binds the report to the declared `policy_version` and
  checks staleness.
- **`Ep2Model`** (`backend.rs`) — the honest in-process `process_sandbox`
  model (§8: the smallest standard layer): fs/net/proc/exec gates with
  symlink resolution before validation; declares exactly the Stage-1
  enforcement surface; every declared-but-unenforced field → a
  `lowering_loss` row (`UnsupportedResource`/`UnsupportedSyscallFilter`/
  `TlsTerminationNotImplemented`/`ProxyConfigurationUnsupported`/
  `ExternalChannelCannotContain`…); never reports `attested`; refuses
  `Ephemeral`/`SubprocessConfined`/above-process classes, `Backend::
  External`, `public`/`bridged` without `residual_channels`, and
  `bridged`+`deny` (`Ep2ModelImpossible`); `warn_and_degrade` degrades
  availability/evidence only — `policy_ref_mismatch`/`stale_report` refuse
  under either mode (integrity, not availability).
- **The probe battery** (`probes.rs`) — hermetic AC-H4-03 shape:
  write-outside-root/protected-metadata/symlink-escape fail;
  `connect`/`sendto`/raw/ICMP/name-resolve fail under `none`/`mediated`;
  `io_uring`/`ptrace`/`process_vm_*`/`setuid` denied; the one bridged
  `AF_UNIX` channel succeeds.
- **`attach`/`verify`** (`attach.rs`) — apply + probe + report;
  fail-closed on helper-absent/`UnsupportedBackend`/`Lab`/stale-report/
  unknown-evidence-for-a-relied-group (I-C4); `warn_and_degrade` stamps
  `containment_degraded`, refuses Lab runs; `PermissionUnreachable`
  findings surface at attach.
- **Events** (`events.rs` + `hh-ledger` class rows) —
  `security.containment.{applied,violated,unverified}` payloads are
  audit-grade and content-free (blob references for probe/lowering-loss
  detail; `subject` is a path/host spelling); `unverified.field_group ∈
  {attach, report, <declared field name>}`.
- **The monitor precondition** (`hh-monitor`) — `Proposal.containment:
  ContainmentGate` is a recorded input checked **before step 0**:
  `Unverified ⇒ deny{ContainmentUnverified}`; `Denied ⇒ deny{containment}`
  — Π is never consulted and `ask` is never produced on a floor refusal
  (ADR-0062 D3; the R-2.8.4 → R-2.8.1 edge the spec's own §6 prescribes).
- **`hh-identity`** — `RecordKind::ContainmentPolicy` (one kind,
  `containment_policy` domain tag).

## Acceptance evidence
- **AC-R-2.8.4-1** — `ac1_write_containment_protected_and_symlink_escape_
  deny` + the probe battery: write-outside-root, `.git/hooks` at depth and
  symlink-escape each deny with a `violated{evidence_kind}` payload.
- **AC-R-2.8.4-3** — `ac3_none_mode_battery_every_connect_fails_only_
  bridge_succeeds`: every network probe fails under `none`; only the
  bridged `AF_UNIX` succeeds; evidence recorded `probed`.
- **AC-R-2.8.4-8** — `ac8_fail_closed_fault_matrix` (helper-absent /
  unsupported-backend / stale-report / unknown-evidence all refuse) +
  `ac8_warn_and_degrade_and_the_lab_rule` (degrade stamps + Lab refused).
- **AC-R-2.8.4-9** — `ac9_meet_property_over_seeded_random_stacks` +
  the `meet_*` unit battery (entitlements, exemptions, deny-survival).
- **AC-R-2.8.4-10** — `ac10_lowering_loss_names_every_unenforceable_
  relied_field`: relied-on losses ⇒ `floor_gate` answers `Unverified`.
- **AC-R-2.8.4-14** — `ac14_unverified_precondition_runs_before_any_check`,
  `ac14_floor_denial_never_consults_pi_or_asks`, `ac8_permission_
  unreachable_warns_at_attach`.
- Live verification: **n/a** — offline-only slice; `Ep2Model` is a model,
  not a live sandbox (real EP2 helper → S2.1, DF-S1.12-3).

## Decisions
- **ADR-0243** — `docs/adr/ADR-0243-s1.12-containment-crate-and-boundary-
  rulings.md`: crate shape; the recorded `ContainmentGate` seam (the
  monitor never evaluates policy); the Stage-1 entitlement table;
  `None`-as-silence on `Option` bounds; the `..`-is-denial path matcher;
  `Ep2Model`'s honesty rules (never `attested`; degrade covers
  availability only); the absent-report ⇒ refuse-all-domains ruling.
